desc: Reformulate the number of obtainable indegree sequences as the number of spanning forests of the underlying graph (graphical zonotope / graphic matroid result).

Build and fully derive a constant-state frontier connectivity DP for counting spanning forests after cutting the outer cycle at vertex 0; give explicit states, transitions for `s_i=0/1`, initialization, and final wraparound handling, then validate it against both samples.
Prove correctness of the spanning-forest characterization and the DP, including all-zero, all-one, and cyclic-boundary special cases.
Produce an implementation-ready O(N)-time, O(1)-memory algorithm modulo 998244353.
